title: Average of an affine function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The uniform average of $(1+g(x))/2$ over $x\in\Omega$ equals one half of $1$ plus the uniform average of $g$ over $\Omega$.
